acr_subtitle: An assessment that has been submitted, is under review or has been validated can only be changed once a request is granted. Until it is validated, the supervisor or manager may cancel it directly, with a reason.
acr_raise_help: Your assessments that you can no longer edit directly. The reason is mandatory; the person who decides will read it.
acr_field_reason_ph: Why does this assessment need to be reopened?
acr_queue_help: Granting hands the assessment back to the person: it is the only thing that reopens the right to change it. A refusal requires a reason.
acr_cancel_help: Possible while the assessment has not been validated. Cancelling is a state plus a reason: nothing is deleted, and an official level already validated is not rewritten. Beyond validation, a request for change is required.
acr_cancel_none: No cancellable assessment within your perimeter.
acr_cancel_reason_ph: Why is this assessment being cancelled?
acr_flash_granted: Request granted: the assessment goes back to the person.
acr_flash_cancelled: Assessment cancelled (state + reason). Nothing was deleted.
acr_raise_other_title: Request a change on someone else's assessment
acr_raise_other_help: The validated assessments of the people in your perimeter. Beyond validation this is the only way in: before it, cancel directly (section below). The person's manager, or an administrator, will decide — you do not decide your own request.
acr_raise_other_none: No validated assessment can take a request today: either nothing is validated in your perimeter, or a request is already open on it, or the 30-day contest window has passed, or the campaign no longer accepts writes.
acr_withdraw_not_yours: Withdrawable by the person who raised it
acr_decide_not_yours: This assessment has been validated: only the person's manager, or an administrator, may decide.
acr_err_sa_not_found: This assessment could not be found.
acr_err_cr_not_found: This request for change could not be found.
acr_err_not_authorized_subject: Only the person concerned, their supervisor or their manager may raise a request on this assessment.
acr_err_not_authorized_reviewer: Restricted to the supervisor, the manager or an administrator of the person concerned.
acr_err_not_authorized_supervisor: Restricted to the person's supervisor or an administrator.
acr_err_request_unnamed: A request must name who raises it: your account could not be identified.
acr_err_reason_required: A reason is required to request a change.
acr_err_already_editable: This assessment is still yours: edit it directly, no request is needed.
acr_err_reopened_by_campaign: Campaign {{cycle}} is asking you for this assessment again: answer it directly, no request is needed.
acr_err_cancel_directly: This assessment has not been validated yet: cancel it directly (state + reason). A request for change is only required beyond validation.
acr_err_state_not_requestable: There is nothing to request on an assessment in the “{{state}}” state.
acr_err_contest_window: The window to contest this assessment has passed: the decision dates from {{decided}} and the {{days}}-day window expired on {{until}}.
acr_err_already_pending: A request is already open on this assessment.
acr_err_already_decided: This request has already been decided ({{outcome}}).
acr_err_invalid_decision: Invalid decision: it must be granted or refused.
acr_err_refuse_reason_required: A reason is required to refuse a request for change.
acr_err_decide_manager_only: This assessment has been validated: only the person's manager, or an administrator, may decide to reopen it.
acr_err_decision_unnamed: A decision must name its decider: your account could not be identified.
acr_err_decide_own: You cannot decide your own request: that is the two-person rule.
acr_err_withdraw_not_requester: Only the person who raised the request may withdraw it.
acr_err_cancel_own: You cannot cancel your own assessment.
acr_err_cancel_reason_required: A reason is required to cancel an assessment.
acr_err_cancel_approved: This assessment has been validated: it can no longer be cancelled directly. Raise a request for change instead.
acr_err_cancel_approved_cycle: This assessment has been validated: it can no longer be cancelled directly. And a request for change cannot be raised on it today — {{gate}} While the campaign stays closed to writing, there is nothing to raise.
acr_err_cancel_approved_window: This assessment has been validated: it can no longer be cancelled directly. And the {{days}}-day window to contest it has passed — the decision dates from {{decided}} and the window expired on {{until}}: a request for change is no longer admissible.
acr_err_cancel_approved_pending: This assessment has been validated: it can no longer be cancelled directly. A request for change (no. {{requestId}}) is already open on it: follow it under “Requests for change” — there can only be one at a time.
acr_err_cancel_state: An assessment in the “{{state}}” state cannot be cancelled.
acr_err_cancel_unnamed: A cancellation must name the person who decides it: your account could not be identified.
acr_err_request_changes_comment: Explain what the person needs to change: the comment is mandatory.
acr_err_stale_state: This assessment has just been actioned by someone else: reload the page to see its current state.
saw_err_employee_not_found: This employee could not be found.
saw_err_cannot_open_review: An assessment in the “{{state}}” state cannot be opened for review.
saw_err_cannot_request_changes: No change can be requested on an assessment in the “{{state}}” state.
saw_err_withdraw_reason_required: A reason is required to withdraw a review.
saw_err_cannot_withdraw_review: There is no review to withdraw on an assessment in the “{{state}}” state.
saw_err_dispute_open: A dispute is open on this review: resolve or withdraw it first.
saw_err_cannot_reopen: An assessment in the “{{state}}” state cannot be reopened.
saw_err_review_own: You cannot review your own assessment.
saw_err_cannot_approve: An assessment in the “{{state}}” state cannot be approved.
saw_err_approve_arbitration_manager_only: An assessment under arbitration can only be closed by its manager or an administrator.
saw_err_rating_range: The reviewer's rating must be a whole number from 0 to 4.
saw_err_rating_reason_required: Give a short reason for rating this skill differently from the person.
saw_err_approval_unnamed: An approval must name the person who gives it: your account could not be identified.
saw_err_reject_reason_required: A reason is required to reject an assessment.
saw_err_cannot_reject: An assessment in the “{{state}}” state cannot be rejected.
saw_err_manager_only: Restricted to the person's manager or an administrator.
saw_err_cannot_validate: An assessment in the “{{state}}” state cannot be validated.
saw_err_validation_unnamed: A validation must name the person who gives it: your account could not be identified.
saw_err_arbitrate_own: You cannot arbitrate your own assessment.
saw_err_cannot_arbitrate: An assessment in the “{{state}}” state cannot be arbitrated.
saw_err_owner_or_reviewer_only: Restricted to the person concerned and their reviewers.
saw_err_comment_not_authorized: You are not authorized to comment on this assessment.
saw_err_view_not_authorized: You are not authorized to view this assessment.
saw_err_timeline_not_authorized: You are not authorized to view this timeline.
